title: Every deploy waits on one person.
points: Releases queue behind a single reviewer
text: Right now, every deploy waits on one person. Releases queue up behind a single reviewer, and the average wait is two days.

title: Automated checks clear the routine cases.
points: The reviewer sees only the risky ones
text: The fix is simple. Routine changes merge as soon as the checks go green, so the reviewer only sees the risky ones.
